thesis: Natural beauty requires neither an intended audience nor benevolence and cannot determine ecological or moral worth.

ideas.statement: Aesthetic value emerges through position and knowledge; distant harmony can omit the suffering within it.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Sublimity differs from reassuring beauty; mind-independent forms, capacities to move observers and actual experiences must be distinguished.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Sublimity differs from reassuring beauty; mind-independent forms, capacities to move observers and actual experiences must be distinguished.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM all-unit analysis; examples and empirical limits preserved.
